inputSchema.description: A two-letter state, a trade from that state's list, and a city, 5-digit zip, or county.

city.description: Exact match after normalizing case and spaces, on addresses in the requested state. Exactly one of city, zip or county.
city.title: City

county.description: Offered only where a state lists it. Exactly one of city, zip or county.
county.title: County

trade.description: A trade slug. Each state offers its own list: GET /v1/license/trades (free)
trade.title: Trade

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP (ZIP+4 accepted; the first 5 digits match). Exactly one of city, zip or county.
zip.title: Zip

inputSchema.title: LicenseSearchRequest

name: license_search

class_code.description: FL: the license's class when the trade names a class inside its license type (e.g. SCC glazing is class GLZ); null when the whole type is the trade. WA: the specialty that matched the trade (e.g. CC roofing is CD). VA: the license's first specialty in the trade (e.g. hvac is HVA or REF). CA: the license's first classification in the trade (e.g. plumbing is C36). Null for OR and TX.
class_code.title: Class Code

status.description: As the state gives it: FL primary status 'C'/'P'/'S'; CA primary status, e.g. 'CLEAR'; OR, TX and VA 'active'/'expired'; WA the L&I status, e.g. 'ACTIVE'.
status.title: Status

truncated.description: total_matches is more than the results returned.
